name: Red Bull Ring
provenance: Approximate GP reconstruction: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), relation 5309181 v8. Elevation: Land Steiermark DGM, CC BY 4.0, Judenburg 2010 flight. Retrieved 2026-09-11. Widths and sectors estimated; not an official survey. See data/sources/red-bull-ring/README.md.

attribution.notes: Mapped GP layout, excluding pit lane and MotoGP chicanes. Periodic interpolation, 720 samples, bilinear DGM heights and 30 m Gaussian height smoothing. Width 12 m and equal-distance sectors are estimates. Scenery is procedural; heights describe 2010 terrain, not a current race-surface survey.
